validation_criteria: EXPLAIN for the calibration queries shows scan-based access on the filtered tables with no usable secondary index on `tag`.
With `slow_query_log=ON` and `log_queries_not_using_indexes=ON`, the fast SELECT workload appears in the slow log even though runtime stays well below `long_query_time`.
With the flag disabled, the same fast workload should not materially populate the slow log.
symptom_evidence: Slow-log lines contain `Query_time` values in the sub-second range.
Logged entries show `Rows_examined` near the underlying table cardinality.
The workload is visible in the slow log despite being much faster than 2 seconds.
mechanism_evidence: EXPLAIN shows table reads on the filtered column without a supporting index.
Toggling `log_queries_not_using_indexes` changes whether the fast queries are logged.
The same query text can remain fast while the slow log eligibility changes.
